Discover Ashwagandha Powder Price Per KG

Ashwagandha powder is made from the dried root of Withania somnifera, a herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations. If you need a bulk ashwagandha powder supplier india, Tradenest Naturals supplies ashwagandha root powder bulk to supplement, tea and food brands overseas. We work as an ashwagandha root powder supplier and exporter, with fine milled powder packed for export.

Why Choose Our Ashwagandha Root Powder?

Raw roots are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean and dry the roots, then fine mill and sieve them into an even powder. Brands that would otherwise approach ashwagandha extract powder suppliers often choose our root powder for its simple, single-ingredient profile.
  • Plain ashwagandha root, with no added fillers or carriers.
  • Fine milled to 80-100 mesh for smooth blending and capsule filling.
  • Product specification sheet shared with every quotation.
  • Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Applications in Food and Supplement Industries

Our ashwagandha powder wholesale supply suits several product formats. Supplement brands fill it into capsules and tablets. Beverage makers blend it into smoothie mixes, protein shakes and herbal teas. It is also used in traditional Ayurvedic churna blends. Buying ashwagandha powder in bulk gives you a steady base ingredient for your range.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Export Standards

Good packing keeps the powder dry and free-flowing. We pack in food-grade, moisture-resistant bags and drums. Moisture is kept at or below 8%, and the shelf life is 24 months when stored cool and dry. Our team gives export documentation support so your shipment moves smoothly.
